office.municipalities.title: Responsible for these municipalities
office.municipalities.description: If you live in one of these municipalities, this civil registry office is generally your official contact for marriage preparation, document checks and the civil ceremony.
office.municipalities.note: Note: marriage preparation normally takes place at the responsible registry office. Depending on the canton and availability, the ceremony may also take place at another authorised venue.
office.faq.municipalities.question: Which municipalities is {office} responsible for?
office.faq.municipalities.answer: {office} is responsible for marriage preparation and civil ceremonies for the listed municipalities, including {municipalities}.
office.faq.documents.question: Which documents do I need?
office.faq.documents.answer: This depends on residence, nationality and civil status. The responsible registry office will confirm the binding document list.
office.faq.booking.question: Can I book a ceremony date directly?
office.faq.booking.answer: Marriage preparation is generally completed first. The date can then be arranged with the office.
office.nextSteps.title: Next steps
office.nextSteps.one: Check whether your municipality of residence or preferred municipality is listed above.
office.nextSteps.two: Contact the office and request your personal document list.
office.nextSteps.three: Allow enough time for foreign documents, translations or legalisations.
office.nextSteps.four: Arrange the ceremony date only after marriage preparation has been confirmed.
office.marriageContract.title: Matrimonial property and marriage contract
office.marriageContract.description: Before the wedding, it can be useful to understand the financial consequences of marriage and the options for a marriage contract.
